intro: You are a field epidemiologist. Two unrelated villagers in Rampur have fever and confusion. Report to the District Health Officer first and get authorization. Baba Kaladev at the Temple Grove can be met at any time. Patients are accompanied by family, who sometimes speak for them. In the end, type your own verdict.

lock.msg: Get authorization from the District Health Officer first.
Ask for the discharged patient's address first.

unlock.permission: Authorization granted: Community Health Center unlocked.
unlock.asha_ok: Rani (ASHA worker) can now meet you.
unlock.ward_ok: You may speak to Jaggu in the isolation ward.

dho.name: Dr. Verma
dho.greet: You're late. Two patients, a panicking village, and my phone has not stopped ringing. Speak quickly.
dho.fallback: Speak clearly. Ask about permission, the situation, past outbreaks or resources. Or name a disease and I'll say possible or not.

topics.label: Report arrival and ask what is known so far
topics.reply: Two patients. Jaggu, 52, a farmer, is admitted at the Community Health Center. Kamala, from the west lane, was discharged yesterday and is still unwell. They are not related and live far apart. That bothers me. The village is shouting about curses and water.

topics.label: Respectfully request authorization to interview staff, patients and families
topics.reply: Fine. Permission granted. Go to the Community Health Center, start with Dr. Sharma, and do not embarrass this office. Baba Kaladev needs no permission, but good luck; he hates doctors.

topics.label: Demand full powers to enter any house and force testing
topics.reply: Do you think this is a police raid? Force makes families hide their sick. Ask properly or don't ask.

topics.label: Ask about past outbreaks in this district
topics.reply: Japanese encephalitis comes in the monsoon. These cases came in winter, which is date palm sap season. Think.
ev: Cases in winter, during sap season

topics.label: Ask who the villagers trust most
topics.reply: Baba Kaladev and Rani, the ASHA worker. Baba is rude and stubborn, but half the village obeys him. Insult him and you lose them all.
ev: Baba and Rani influence the village

topics.label: Ask what lab and PPE support the district can provide
topics.reply: Samples reach the state virology lab in a day. PPE is limited; don't ask for the moon. Tell me exactly what you need.

topics.label: Say you are ready to give your final verdict
topics.reply: About time. Get linked contacts and a clear source first, then use the verdict button and write it yourself. No guesses.

topics.label: Ask how to test a hypothesis with him
topics.reply: Type a disease name and I'll say possible or not. Yes or no. Nothing more.

dho.hello: Skip the pleasantries. What do you want?

hyp.ok: YES. Possible. Fever with brain swelling, no bacteria, winter sap season: it fits. Now prove the source.
hyp.weak: YES, possible. But you haven't shown me evidence yet. Go and get it.

hyp.reply: NO. Not possible. Nobody has diarrhoea and the lab shows no bacteria. Next.
NO. The spray was weeks ago and the cattle are fine. Next.
NO. It's winter. Mosquito season is over. Use your head.
NO. No animal bites, and rabies does not strike two strangers together.
NO. Curses do not show up in CSF.
NO. Wrong pattern. Fever with brain swelling and no cough cluster.
NO, not bacterial. The CSF shows no bacteria. Think viral.

doctor.name: Dr. Sharma
doctor.greet: Thank goodness you're here. Jaggu, 52, was admitted two days ago with high fever and confusion. A second patient, Kamala, was discharged yesterday but is still unwell. They are not related. People say it's a curse or poisoned water.
doctor.guarded: I'd rather not speculate yet. Let's build trust and gather more first.
doctor.fallback: I'm not sure I follow. Try asking about lab results, symptoms, other causes, samples or isolation.

topics.label: What do the CSF and lab results show?
topics.reply: CSF shows raised lymphocytes and protein with no bacteria. It is acute viral encephalitis: swelling of the brain.
ev: No bacteria in CSF or blood

topics.label: Have you ruled out cholera or typhoid?
topics.reply: Yes. Stool and blood tests are negative and nobody has diarrhoea. The handpump has been broken for weeks, and families boil their water anyway. It is not waterborne.

topics.label: Thank Dr. Sharma and ask how the clinic is coping
topics.reply: That means a lot. The second patient is Kamala, from the west lane. She has no relation to Jaggu. We discharged her yesterday because we had no bed, but she is still not well.
ev: P1 and P2 are not relatives

topics.label: Why haven't you isolated them properly?
topics.reply: Jaggu is in the only side room. We have few masks. I can do better with district help.

topics.label: When did symptoms start? What's the timeline?
topics.reply: Fever began about 5 days ago. Jaggu says it came a few days after something he hasn't fully described to me.

topics.label: What symptoms does Jaggu have besides fever?
topics.reply: Headache, vomiting, drowsiness, breathlessness, and a seizure last night. The breathing trouble worries me; this is not typical meningitis.

topics.label: Have you sent samples to a virology lab?
topics.reply: Throat swab, urine and CSF went out this morning. Results in about two days. Until then, treat this as a suspected novel viral encephalitis.
ev: Samples sent to the virology lab

topics.label: Ask what worries him most
topics.reply: My staff. Two nurses handled Jaggu without masks before we suspected anything. If this spreads person to person, they are at risk.

topics.label: May I speak to Jaggu?
topics.reply: Five minutes, with a mask. He is confused, so be gentle. I'll let the ward know.

topics.label: Who can help trace contacts in the village?
topics.reply: Rani, our ASHA worker. She knows every household. She's in the clinic today; I'll introduce you.

doctor.hello: Yes, hello. Please be quick, I have patients waiting.

asha_worker.name: Rani

lock.msg: Dr. Sharma should introduce you to Rani first.

asha_worker.greet: Namaste. Dr. Sharma said you would come. I know every house in Rampur. How can I help?
asha_worker.guarded: People are scared. I can't say more until they trust you.
asha_worker.fallback: Hmm? Ask me about the villagers, sap customs, the sugarcane spray, Baba-ji, or Kamala.

topics.label: Ask what she is hearing in the community
topics.reply: Two families in the east hamlet have young men bedridden with fever. They won't come here because Baba-ji said hospital needles will kill them.
ev: Unreported fever cases in east hamlet

topics.label: Could the sugarcane pesticide spray be the cause?
topics.reply: The spray was three weeks ago. Farmhands and cattle are fine. Only a few people are sick, and not all of them farm.
ev: Spray timing and spread don't fit

topics.label: Demand a list of everyone who is sick, now
topics.reply: If you push like that, families will hide their sick even more. Please don't make me choose between you and my neighbours.

topics.label: Ask how to win over Baba Kaladev
topics.reply: Respect him first. Don't argue about the curse. Ask about the sacred grove; he watches it every night.

topics.label: Ask for Kamala's address so you can visit her
topics.reply: West lane, behind the tailor's shop, blue gate. Kamala is home, weak and forgetful, and her son Mohan is with her. Wear a mask and be gentle.

topics.label: Ask about local customs around date palm sap
topics.reply: In winter men tap the palms at night and leave pots to fill. At dawn people drink it raw, cold and sweet. Many believe it's good for health.
ev: Raw sap drunk fresh at dawn in winter

topics.label: Ask how families are coping and what they need
topics.reply: They fear losing wages. Vikram's wife says he has a cough and fever now, and she moved the children to her mother's.
ev: Sap collector now has fever and cough

topics.label: Ask who has been caring for the patients
topics.reply: Jaggu's daughter Lakshmi nursed him at home for two days. Nobody wore masks, and she cleaned his vomit by hand.

asha_worker.hello: Namaste. Tell me how I can help.

patient_1.name: Jaggu (Patient 1)

lock.msg: Ask Dr. Sharma for permission to speak to Jaggu in the isolation ward.

patient_1.greet: Please be gentle. Papa is very weak. I will speak for him when he cannot.
patient_1.fallback: (Jaggu mumbles.) Ask about what I ate... or when I fell ill.

topics.label: Gently ask what he ate or drank before falling ill
topics.reply: I only drank the sweet sap, two full cups raw, before sunrise five days ago. Vikram from our lane brought it.
ev: Drank raw date palm sap 5 days ago

topics.label: Did anyone share handpump water with you?
topics.reply: My family used the old pump sometimes. But I felt sick before that... the water is not it.

topics.label: Where did Vikram get the sap and who else buys it?
topics.reply: He taps the palms near the sacred grove, then sells pots at the bus stand at dawn. Half the village buys from him.
ev: Vikram sells raw sap to many customers

topics.label: Order him to stay strictly in bed
topics.reply: Please don't shout. He is very sick and frightened.

topics.label: Ask about family and who stayed close this week
topics.reply: My daughter Lakshmi stayed with me. Neighbours came and held my hand.

topics.label: Did you notice anything unusual at the palms or pots?
topics.reply: The pot was sticky, with chewed fruit bits and something like bite marks. Wings were flapping above before sunrise... I didn't think about it.
ev: Chewed fruit and bite marks near sap pots

topics.label: When did he first feel unwell?
topics.reply: Headache and fever about four days after the sap. Then I started forgetting things.

patient_2.name: Kamala (Patient 2)
patient_2.greet: Please come in. Amma gets dizzy if she stands. The doctor sent her home because there was no bed.
patient_2.guarded: I... don't remember... please, not now.
patient_2.fallback: (Kamala rubs her forehead.) Ask me about how I feel, the sap, the visitors, or Jaggu.

topics.label: Ask how she is feeling and offer her a seat
topics.reply: Headaches, dizziness, and I forget words. I'm scared they'll take me back to the ward.

topics.label: What does she remember eating or drinking before she fell ill?
topics.reply: I bought a pot of raw sap at the bus stand at dawn, from Vikram. I drank it all the next morning. It was cold and sweet.
ev: Drank raw date palm sap 5 days ago
P1 and P2 both bought from Vikram

topics.label: When did her symptoms begin?
topics.reply: Fever and a terrible headache four days after the sap. Then I did not recognise my own son.
ev: Onset about 4 to 5 days after exposure

topics.label: Ask whether she knows or is related to Jaggu
topics.reply: Jaggu? I only know his face from the market. We are not related, and I have never been to his house.
ev: P1 and P2 never had direct contact

topics.label: Tell her she must go back to hospital immediately
topics.reply: (Starts crying) No... I just came home. Please don't send me back.

topics.label: Offer a home check with Dr. Sharma and a mask
topics.reply: Yes... that would help. I would feel safer. I'll wear the mask for the family.

topics.label: Ask Mohan how he has been caring for her
topics.reply: I cleaned her when she vomited and held her through the seizures. No gloves, no mask. I have had a headache since last night.
ev: Caregiver exposed to patient's body fluids

topics.label: Who has visited since she came home?
topics.reply: Neighbours and my aunt. They all touched her face and cried.

baba.name: Baba Kaladev
baba.greet: Another city fool with needles! Get out of my grove!
baba.guarded: You haven't earned a word from me. Get lost.
baba.fallback: Speak plainly, fool, or leave. Ask about the grove, the sick, or the sap.

topics.label: Respectfully thank Baba-ji and ask about the grove
topics.reply: (Grudgingly) Hmph. At least you speak like a human. The grove has been disturbed. Since the trees were cut, the village has fallen sick. Don't think I like you.
ev: Curse belief; trees cut near grove

topics.label: Ask if he noticed animals near the sap pots
topics.reply: Fine, since you bowed properly. The big night-bats nest in those palms in huge numbers. They eat the fruit and drink from the sap pots left overnight. Now stop pestering me.
ev: Fruit bats roost in grove palms
Bats drink from open sap pots

topics.label: Tell him the curse is dangerous misinformation
topics.reply: You dare, you arrogant fool! Get out of my grove before I curse your whole family!

topics.label: Ask him to tell villagers the clinic is safe
topics.reply: Hmph. If you honour the grove, I'll tell them the clinic is no enemy. Not for you. For them. The hidden ones will come.

topics.label: Ask him to tell the story of the sacred grove
topics.reply: My ancestors planted these palms for the goddess. A greedy contractor cut trees for the new road, and the bats lost their trees and came here. You city people understand nothing.
ev: Habitat loss pushed bats into grove

topics.label: Ask when he first noticed villagers falling sick
topics.reply: A week ago Jaggu came to me burning with fever, after a morning with the sap. I gave him herbs. Don't look at me like that, I did what I could.
ev: Jaggu ill about a week ago

topics.label: Ask who collects the sap and how it is stored
topics.reply: Vikram taps at night and leaves the pots open under the crowns until dawn, then sells them at the bus stand. People pay good money for it, fools.
ev: Open pots left under palms overnight

topics.label: Ask for his blessing and help to reach hidden families
topics.reply: Hmph. Go with my blessing. I'll send word to the east hamlet. The sick can go to your clinic, and I will pray for them. Now leave.

baba.hello: What do you want, outsider? Be quick.

plan.t: Ban or avoid raw sap; advise boiling or discarding
Cover sap pots/trees with bamboo skirts or nets against bats
Isolate cases and trace contacts, including hidden cases
Infection control and PPE for health workers and caregivers
Community engagement with Baba, Rani and families

harm.t: Spraying insecticide as the main response
